review.reviewBody: I had never left Nigeria before this tour and I was nervous about crossing into Benin Republic. The team made the whole process easy and the guide explained everything at every step. By the time we reached the Door of No Return in Ouidah, all the nerves were gone. This was one of the most meaningful days of my life.

I was in Lagos for a conference and had a free weekend. A colleague pointed me to Visit Badagry and it turned out to be the best decision of the entire trip. The guide was outstanding, the history was presented with real depth, and crossing into Benin Republic and Togo felt completely seamless.

As a Nigerian-American, this tour was deeply personal. Walking the Route des Esclaves in Ouidah and then standing at the Door of No Return, I cannot describe what that felt like. Visit Badagry made the logistics effortless so I could just be present with my thoughts and ancestors.

I never expected a trip to West Africa to affect me this deeply. From Badagry to Ouidah to Lomé, every stop on this tour carried a weight I was not fully prepared for. The guide was thoughtful, knowledgeable, and made us feel genuinely welcomed at every destination.

I organised a group trip for 12 of us from work and I was nervous about coordinating everything. Visit Badagry handled every single detail. The guide was exceptional, the timing was spot on, and our colleagues are still talking about it weeks later.

I flew in from Port Harcourt specifically for this tour and it was worth every bit of the journey. The cross-border experience into Benin Republic was seamless. Our guide handled everything at the Seme border without any stress.
